title: Perfect matching with compatible labels
statement: Let $q,k,n$ be natural numbers. A graph matching labeling consists of a perfect matching in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part, together with a labeling of its vertices by an $n$-element set, such that the endpoints of every matching edge have the same label.
hypotheses_covered: The graph is complete $q$-partite with $k$ vertices in each part
The vertices are labeled by an $n$-element set
Labels agree across every matching edge
